questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.An.22 pramāṇe, "Je harijanne viṣhe kudṛuṣhṭi rākhe te atishay pāpī chhe ne teno koī kāḷe ______ thāy nahī."
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Je harijanne viṣhe kudṛuṣhṭi rākhe te atishay pāpī chhe ne teno koī kāḷe chhūṭko thāy nahī."

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.An.22 pramāṇe, Satsangī harijanne kevā kahyā chhe?
options: jevā potānā mā, ben ke dīkrī hoy tevā
jevā potānā bhāi ke bāp hoy tevā
questions.correct_answer: jevā potānā mā, ben ke dīkrī hoy tevā
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Satsangī harijan chhe te to jevā potānā mā, ben ke dīkrī hoy tevā chhe..."

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.An.22 pramāṇe, "Upar kudṛuṣhṭie jovāyu hoy to tenu ______ chhe."
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Upar kudṛuṣhṭie jovāyu hoy to tenu vadhu pāp chhe..."

questions.question_text: Premanand Swami rachit kirtan pramāṇe, "Bāio dekhīne bhāio, ______ chāle."
questions.explanation: The kirtan states, "Bāio dekhīne bhāio, chheṭerā chāle..."

questions.question_text: Premanand Swami rachit kirtan pramāṇe, "...Paḍī vastu koīnī, ______ nav jhāle rāj."
questions.explanation: The kirtan states, "Paḍī vastu koīnī, hāthe nav jhāle rāj..."

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Vach.Ga.An.22 pramāṇe, je harijanne viṣhe kudṛuṣhṭi rākhe teno koī kāḷe chhūṭko nahī thāy kem?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Je harijanne viṣhe kudṛuṣhṭi rākhe te atishay pāpī chhe ne teno koī kāḷe chhūṭko thāy nahī."

questions.question_text: Premanand Swami rachit kirtan pramāṇe, Bāio dekhīne bhāio kevu chālvu joīe ane koīnī paḍelī vastu māṭe shu karvu joīe?
questions.explanation: The kirtan states, "Bāio dekhīne bhāio, chheṭerā chāle, Paḍī vastu koīnī, hāthe nav jhāle rāj..."

questions.question_text: Vach.Ga.An.22 pramāṇe, Satsangī harijanne viṣhe kudṛuṣhṭi rākhvāvāḷā māṭe nīce nāmānthī satya vidhan shodho.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Je harijanne viṣhe kudṛuṣhṭi rākhe te atishay pāpī chhe ne teno koī kāḷe chhūṭko thāy nahī."

questions.question_text: 'Drushtino Sanyam ane pavitrata' shirṣhak nīce, nīce nāmānthī kayā Vachanamrutno ullekh thayel chhe?
'Drushtino Sanyam ane pavitrata' shirṣhak nīce, kayā Santnu kirtan āpel chhe?
questions.explanation: The Kirtan section explicitly lists "Premanand Swami".
